title: Ana's Stickers
text:
Ana has forty stickers. Twenty stickers are red and twenty are blue. Ana likes her stickers very much.

Her brother Leo has sixty stickers. He gives Ana ten stickers. Now Ana has fifty stickers.

questions.text: How many red stickers does Ana have?
How many stickers does Leo have at first?
How does Ana probably feel about her stickers?
options: She wants to throw them away.

questions.text: What kind of brother is Leo?

vocabulary.definition: small pieces of paper with a picture or design on one side
the colour of blood or a tomato
a boy or man who has the same parents as you

paragraph_translations: Ana tiene cuarenta calcomanías. Veinte calcomanías son rojas y veinte son azules. A Ana le gustan mucho sus calcomanías.
Su hermano Leo tiene sesenta calcomanías. Él le da diez calcomanías a Ana. Ahora Ana tiene cincuenta calcomanías.
